450:t_014:1.en:
$$ラルク$$
「I won't lose...! I refuse to lose!!」

450:t_014:2.en:
$$ラルク$$
「I won't hand over the place $$ノノ$$ comes back to the likes of you!!」

450:t_015:0.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「Dodge, $$ラルク$$! An attack is coming!」

450:t_017:2.en:
$$チコ$$
「And you were supposed to be on the Moon...!」

450:t_017:3.en:
$$バスターマシン７号$$
「A warp! For the bond between $$ノノ$$ and Big Sis, distance no longer matters!」

450:t_017:5.en:
$$バスターマシン７号$$
「$$地球帝国宇宙軍$$ Solar System Direct Cover Unit, Sixth-Generation Interstellar Decisive Battle Weapon, $$バスターマシン７号$$!」

450:t_017:8.en:
$$バスターマシン７号$$
「And...! $$ノノ$$ was truly a fool!」

450:t_017:10.en:
$$バスターマシン７号$$
「I've actually known ever since $$シンジ$$ said it to me!」

450:t_017:11.en:
$$バスターマシン７号$$
「It doesn't matter whether there's a $$バスターマシン$$ or not!」

450:t_017:13.en:
$$バスターマシン７号$$
「Anyone who thinks 'if only I had a $$バスターマシン$$' can never be a true Top! Because...!」

450:t_017:14.en:
$$バスターマシン７号$$
「True power dwells in those who believe in their own strength to the very end!」

450:t_018:1.en:
$$バスターマシン７号$$
「I'm sure a real $$バスターマシン$$ pilot...! A real $$ノノリリ$$...!」

450:t_018:2.en:
$$バスターマシン７号$$
「Carries a $$バスターマシン$$ in their heart!!」

450:t_020:0.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「All units, regroup! Re-form the formation around $$ノノ$$ and push the $$宇宙怪獣$$ back!!」

450:t_020:2.en:
$$甲児$$
「Like I'd let $$ノノ$$ beat me!」

450:t_020:3.en:
$$タケル$$
「We'll believe in our own strength to the very end, too!」

450:t_020:4.en:
$$葵$$
「We'll fight all the way through with that strength!!」

450:t_020:5.en:
$$バスターマシン７号$$
「Let's go, everyone! With hard work and guts!!」

450:t_021:2.en:
$$ヨーコ$$
「Is that the 'beginning of the end' thing $$ミカゲ$$ was talking about?」

450:t_021:4.en:
$$竜馬$$
「What has begun is the fight against $$バアル$$. It is certainly not the end of the universe.」

450:t_021:6.en:
$$バスターマシン７号$$
「Yes...! $$ノノ$$ will fight with everything she has, too!」

450:t_021:7.en:
$$バスターマシン７号$$
「As $$バスターマシン７号$$, as a $$トップレス$$, together with Big Sis!」

450:t_021:9.en:
$$バスターマシン７号$$
「Big Sis... I'm late with my greeting, but $$ノノ$$... has returned just now.」

450:t_022:0.en:
$$カレン$$
「That's what I call taking them all out in one go!」

450:t_022:1.en:
$$スザク$$
「Don't let your guard down! The enemy is pushing with numbers!」

450:t_022:2.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Then we'll just deal with them all at once! Let's go!」

450:t_023:0.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「Nice work, $$ノノ$$! ...Or should I call you $$バスターマシン７号$$?」

450:t_023:1.en:
$$バスターマシン７号$$
「$$ノノ$$ is $$ノノ$$. Call me whatever you like, $$ノリコ$$.」

450:t_023:2.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「Got it! Let's keep working together, $$ノノ$$!」

450:t_023:4.en:
$$バスターマシン７号$$
「What's wrong, Big Sis?」

450:t_023:6.en:
$$ラルク$$
(There's no way I can say it... That for a moment, $$ノリコ$$ and $$ノノ$$ felt so far away...)

450:t_100:0.en:
$$カヲル$$
「What did you talk about with that girl, $$ノノ$$?」

450:t_100:2.en:
$$カヲル$$
「I don't mean to pry. It's just that it's been a while since you started talking to someone on your own, $$シンジ$$.」

450:t_100:4.en:
$$シンジ$$
「It's just... $$ノノ$$... There was something a little like me about her...」

450:t_100:7.en:
$$カヲル$$
「That's why I feel at ease with you. Now, let's go.」

450:t_101:0.en:
$$ニコラ$$
(Every last one of them says whatever they like, with no idea how I feel...)

450:t_101:1.en:
$$ニコラ$$
(But I'll definitely avoid reaching $$あがり$$...! That's why I made a connection with those sisters!)

450:t_102:0.en:
$$ラルク$$
(You just wait, $$ノノ$$...! I'll make the place you come back to...!)

450:t_102:1.en:
$$ラルク$$
(So you don't have to worry about anything! You don't have to become $$ノノリリ$$, just stay with me!)

450:t_103:0.en:
$$ノリコ$$
(What is this sense of wrongness I get from the Solar System-limited kind...?)

450:t_103:1.en:
$$ノリコ$$
(Is there something about them beyond being $$宇宙怪獣$$ from a parallel world...?)

450:t_104:0.en:
$$ノリコ$$
(The $$地球帝国宇宙軍$$, huh... I haven't heard that in a long time...)

450:t_104:1.en:
$$ノリコ$$
(Even if they're from a parallel world, with the $$地球帝国宇宙軍$$ and a $$バスターマシン$$ together again, I can't afford to lose...!)

450:t_104:2.en:
$$ノリコ$$
(Big Sis $$カズミ$$... $$ノリコ$$ will do it too! To protect the two Earths, I'll fight alongside $$ガンバスター$$ with everything I've got!)

450:t_105:0.en:
$$ラルク$$
(What are you, $$ノノ$$...? Why does such a tiny body have more combat power than a $$バスターマシン$$...?)

450:t_105:1.en:
$$バスターマシン７号$$
「Big Sis! When you're in a pinch, that's when you need hard work and guts!」

450:t_105:2.en:
$$ラルク$$
「I told you I hate that kind of thing!」

450:t_105:3.en:
$$バスターマシン７号$$
「You're finally back to your usual self, Big Sis! Then let's go!」

uncertain: 450:t_104:2: Noriko's お姉さま (Kazumi, not Lal'C; see 449 slice 02 t_10) rendered 'Big Sis $$カズミ$$' - name added to disambiguate from Lal'C; she also refers to herself as 'Noriko' as in the Japanese.
450:t_017:5: 直掩部隊 = 'Direct Cover Unit', 第６世代型恒星間航行決戦兵器 = 'Sixth-Generation Interstellar Decisive Battle Weapon' (my own rendering, not official English).
450:t_017:13/018:1: 本当のトップ = 'a true Top' (Top vs Topless wordplay; no glossary entry for bare Top).
450:t_016:0/1: speaker of 'protected me' left as 'You' (BM7 arriving); reply from ??? is Nono.
450:t_100:1/6/8 reuse Jigoku English (Eh... um... / Huh... / Yeah...!).
